The '''Chirrion system''' was located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="RAS2" /> it was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Chirrion Base]], one of the 752 [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] bases that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained in the Rolion [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chirrion [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
